articles.summary: Reach Power (Reach) announced today it has been selected as one of five companies to join the Panasonic Accelerator by Electric Works Company, an exclusive innovation program led by Panasonic Corporation and ReGACY Innovation Group Inc.
articles.title: Reach Selected for Panasonic Accelerator Program

articles.summary: Power beaming could allow an orbiting space-based power station to deliver one gigawatt of solar power, enough to power about 1 million homes annually.
articles.title: Wireless Electricity Is on the Horizon—And It Could ‘Beam’ Power Right to Your House
